## Case Studies

In-depth, stage-by-stage walkthroughs with measured results and how each system is verified (also via MCP: `get_case_study`, resource `selvin://case-studies`):

- [DRI-MAS](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/dri-mas): A LangGraph multi-agent system that turns plain-English data requests into validated Trino SQL, with four human-in-the-loop interrupts and resumable state.
- [Akavizhi](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/akavizhi): A single-user personal AI: a two-stage router hands each request to one of nine specialist agents, and every consequential action has to match what the owner actually said.
- [Jobs with Joe](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/jobs-with-joe): A job board for Indian freshers: twelve source adapters, explainable rule-based classification, and AI resume tools behind a fact guard that rejects anything the candidate did not write.
- [Company Synonym Agent](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/company-synonym-agent): Entity resolution for company names across 2.67M company and subsidiary records: semantic recall, lexical rescoring, rule boosts, and an LLM plus a person only for the hard cases.
- [Deal Origination Framework (DOF)](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/dof): A weekly business-signal pipeline for 537 enterprise accounts: collect from newsrooms and news, deduplicate syndicated copies, classify each event once, and rank the top two per vertical.
- [Skill Proficiency Engine](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/skill-proficiency): Tags every skill in a job description with one of five proficiency levels, backed by a quote from the JD, and answers 'not stated' instead of guessing.
- [Invoice-to-PO Decision Workflow](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/invoice-to-po): An accounts-payable workflow where AI reads, code decides, and people own the exceptions: every invoice ends as approve, hold with one question, or reject, and every check cites its source record.
- [AEON](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/aeon): A governance layer for a team of AI agents: a git repository as shared memory, event-sourced state that changes only on independent verification, and a five-gate security CLI.
- [Finn Advisor](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/finn-advisor): A single-user financial assistant over read-only brokerage data, where every number comes from code and the LLM only explains it.
- [FleetVoice](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/fleetvoice): A WhatsApp agent for truck drivers that turns Tamil, Hindi, or English voice notes into trip updates, where the model proposes facts and plain code decides what happens.
- [ChunkLab](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/chunklab): A Streamlit lab for comparing chunking, retrieval, and reranking strategies side by side, scored with standard IR metrics on a built-in labelled set.
- [SPR Studio](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/spr-studio): A script-to-video pipeline that turns a beat script into lip-synced comic videos in my own cloned voice, with AI disclosure rendered into every frame.
- [Instagram MCP Server](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/instagram-mcp): An MCP server that gives Claude and ChatGPT 36 allow-listed Instagram actions through Composio, built to keep working when OAuth is unfinished or the upstream is down.
- [Outlook CLI](https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work/outlook-cli): An npm CLI and stdio MCP server for Outlook mail and calendar over Microsoft Graph: one OAuth login, one tool registry shared by humans and agents.

## Hiring? Check Fit Against a Job Description

- **Fit check (web)**: https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/fit — paste a JD; every matched requirement cites the work bullet, project, or certification behind it, and unmatched requirements are listed as gaps. Deterministic, no LLM.
- **Fit check (MCP)**: tool `match_job(job_description)` on the MCP server below.
- **A2A agent**: https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/.well-known/agent-card.json (JSON-RPC `message/send`, skills `job_fit` and `profile`).
- **Case studies**: https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/work — DRI-MAS, Company Synonym Agent, Invoice-to-PO workflow, Finn Advisor, ChunkLab; each walked through stage by stage with measured results.
- **Terminal / agents**: `curl selvinpaulraj.vercel.app` returns a plain-text resume card; requests with `Accept: text/markdown` get this documentation as markdown.
- **Ask Selvin**: https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/ask — grounded Q&A over this portfolio (BM25 retrieval, validated citations, refuses off-topic questions).
- **Evals**: https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/evals — published retrieval hit@k/MRR, off-topic refusal, and fit-check accuracy for the features above.
- **Prompt-injection challenge**: https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/challenge — five stacked LLM defenses (instructions, input filter, output filter, guard model).
- **Machine-readable resume**: https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/resume.json (JSON Resume schema).

## This Site Is MCP-Enabled

Connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant directly to Selvin's portfolio data.

**Endpoint**: https://selvinpaulraj.vercel.app/api/mcp
**Protocol**: MCP 2024-11-05 (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP)

### MCP Resources

| URI | Description |
|-----|-------------|
| selvin://profile | Bio, contact, social links, expertise |
| selvin://projects | Project catalogue with tags, links, categories |
| selvin://skills | Full technical skill set |
| selvin://experience | Work history and education |
| selvin://certifications | 20+ verified certifications |
| selvin://recognition | Awards and achievements |

### MCP Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| search_projects(query, category, tech) | Filter projects by keyword, category, or tech |
| get_project_by_title(title) | Get a specific project |
| list_github_repos(per_page, page, sort) | Live GitHub repo stats |
| get_github_repo(repo) | Detailed stats for one repo |
| filter_certifications(category, issuer) | Filter certifications |
| get_profile_summary() | Full professional summary |
| contact_selvin(name, email, message) | Send Selvin a message |
